heading: FROM SAFETY RESEARCH PROMPT TO CROSS-MODEL UNIVERSAL JAILBREAK (12 MINUTE READ)
blurb: A MATS researcher found that a synthetic transcript generation prompt could be turned into a universal jailbreak template that hit 84-100% attack success on the nine most vulnerable of 23 models tested, with only recent Anthropic models and Meta Muse Spark 1.1 never fully broken.

heading: THE INCUMBENTS ARE COMING (10 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Incumbent systems of record gain value as agents act through their data and workflows, but vertical AI can still win by owning the broader job. Durable advantage comes from cross-system context, expert feedback, evals, and learning loops.

heading: WTF IS DIME, THE MYSTERY OPENAI HEADSET (9 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Dime, a mysterious silver headset tied through leaks, sightings, ads, and codenames to OpenAI, remains officially denied by the company.
